title: Specialized visual-place-recognition identity source
summary: Test whether dedicated VPR descriptors provide cross-view positive place authority before any target-to-portal spatial grounding.

mechanisms.name: Single-frame VPR place-identity ceiling
mechanisms.description: Freeze portal and active-view modules; compare whole-image CLIP, DINOv2, fixed CLIP+DINO, SALAD, and MixVPR with Development-calibrated requested-entity acceptance on a building-disjoint cohort.
mechanisms.limitations: On the first PB2-A confirmation, SALAD reduced the source-label negative proxy but lost correct positive coverage, while MixVPR recovered coverage only with an excessive proxy rate. Physical target-absent rejection was not evaluable because co-visible gallery identities were not exhaustively frozen. The frozen single-frame appearance-only route is closed on that cohort.
